title: Pernod Ricard Primes Potential Mumbai Listing as Drinking Booms in India - WSJ
summary: Pernod Ricard Primes Potential Mumbai Listing as Drinking Booms in India WSJ
ai_summary: Pernod Ricard is considering a potential listing in Mumbai amid a surge in drinking in India. The move reflects the company's strategy to tap into the growing Indian market.
